newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila okays C&W unit's local lines project.
newsitem.headline: Manila okays C&W unit's local lines project.

text.p: Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc (ETPI) said on Thursday that the National Telecommunications Commission had given a provisional authority for it to operate local exchange telephone lines.
ETPI, an international gateway operator, is 40 percent owned by Cable & Wireless plc.
ETPI chairman Melquiades Gutierrez said in a statement the 300,000 line project will cost 9.34 billion pesos over the next five years.
Investments during the initial year have been estimated at 1.8 billion pesos.
